MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

For more information about the role, refer to the attached position description or contact talent@epworth.org.au or call (03) 9426 0606.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help us deliver smarter, data-driven healthcare solutions.

Apply now! Click I'm Interested and submit your CV and cover letter as a single document including brief responses to the selection criteria questions above.

Early applications are encouraged - shortlisting will commence immediately.

Apply now. we've over 8,000 perspectives at Epworth and we're ready to welcome yours!

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.

As a child safe organisation, all successful applicants are required to satisfactorily clear a National Police Check (conducted by Epworth) and may be required to hold a valid employee Working with Children Check (provided by you).

At Epworth, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential to our culture and values. We focus on fairness and opportunity for all - across race, ability, ethnicity, gender, age, sexuality, cultures and beliefs - that reflect the communities we work in. At Epworth, we care. result.description:
## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

We are looking for a results-driven and commercially minded ICT Business Development Manager to join our team and play a pivotal role in expanding our market presence across Australia. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within the ICT sector, while nurturing existing client relationships to drive sustained revenue growth. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of ICT products and services, a consultative sales approach, and a proven track record of exceeding targets. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning our solutions with their evolving technology needs.

- Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within the ICT sector, building a robust pipeline of prospective clients across target industries.
- Visit and engage with both existing and prospective client organisations to understand their ICT environments, uncover challenges, and present tailored solutions that address their specific needs.
- Develop and execute strategic business development plans in alignment with organisational goals, market trends, and revenue targets.
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and senior leaders across client accounts.
- Promote and articulate the value of the organisation's ICT goods and services to clients through presentations, proposals, demonstrations, and consultative discussions.
- Assess and analyse customer requirements to recommend appropriate products, services, and technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
- Collaborate closely with internal technical, pre-sales, and delivery teams to develop compelling proposals and ensure seamless handover upon deal closure.
- Monitor market activity, competitor offerings, and emerging ICT trends to inform go-to-market strategies and maintain a competitive edge.
- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms in line with company policies and client expectations, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.

## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Commerce, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, or account management within the ICT industry.
- Strong understanding of ICT products, services, and solutions, including areas such as cloud computing, networking, cybersecurity, managed services, or software.
- Proven ability to develop and manage a sales pipeline, meeting or exceeding revenue targets consistently.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage confidently at all organisational levels.
- Consultative sales approach with the ability to understand complex client needs and translate them into viable technology solutions.

We help people who have been involved in a car accident by handling all aspects of the claim from providing a replacement car to making sure their car is back on the road in no time.

The opportunity
We’re looking for a proven new-business sales professional who knows how to open doors, build influence, and win share with collision repairers, tow companies, vehicle dealerships and insurance brokers across Melbourne, Victoria.

If you already have strong relationships with repairers, dealers, or automotive referrers, and you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, get your hands dirty, and do what it takes to win and keep business, this role is built for you.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will own and grow the Victorian territory, with a primary focus on:
Winning new repairers, tow companies, dealers and insurance brokers
Expanding engagement with existing referrers
Driving sustained revenue growth through disciplined sales activity

This is a field-based, relationship-driven role where success comes from consistent prospecting, face-to-face engagement, and commercial follow-through.

You’ll plan and execute your own sales rhythm, identifying targets, booking visits, educating partners on our value proposition, and converting opportunities into long-term referrer relationships.

This role involves regular travel throughout Victoria to support new and existing accounts. From time to time, you will also travel outside Victoria to support national sales initiatives, key accounts, or strategic opportunities, working closely with the wider team. Importantly, this is not a “stay in the office” sales role. When needed, you will be on the ground supporting operations, including assisting customers, and helping resolve issues in real time. You see this as part of building trust, not someone else’s problem.

What you’ll be doing
Proactively hunting new business with collision repairers, tow companies, dealerships and insurance brokers
Leveraging existing industry relationships to accelerate growth
Building trusted partnerships through regular, structured visits
